name: Nie no Hakoniwa
source:
The first title by NEKO WORKs's sister brand, Chatte Noire.
A visual novel epic filled with madness and a complex mix of love and hate.

[i] Let's celebrate—the birth of this nightmare.[/i]

In a time long past, the oppressed sparked a rebellion with the aid of a "box" introduced by a stranger.

With time, these once subjugated individuals thrived as the prestigious Seven Noble Families. Yet, the Shiki, at the helm of this lineage, faced a dilemma due to the absence of male successors. This led them to welcome a young man from beyond their borders to continue their legacy.

This young man was named Yasaka Kurou.

His encounter with Kyouko, the Shiki's eldest daughter, started a unique connection. Despite their vastly different lives, a mutual attraction soon blossomed between them.

And on their wedding day—a nightmare was born.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://chattenoire.com/hakoniwa/]the official site[/url]]
translation:
NEKO WORKs的姊妹品牌Chatte Noire的第一款作品。
一部充满疯狂和爱与恨的复杂混合体的视觉小说史诗。

[i]让我们庆祝一下——这场噩梦的诞生。[/i]

很久以前，被压迫者借助陌生人引入的“盒子”引发了叛乱。

随着时间的推移，这些曾经被征服的人逐渐成为享有声望的七贵族家族。然而，作为这一世系掌舵人的子规却因缺乏男性继承人而面临困境。这导致他们欢迎一位来自境外的年轻人来延续他们的遗产。

这个年轻人名叫八坂九郎。

他与志贵的长女杏子的相遇，开始了一段独特的联系。尽管他们的生活截然不同，但他们之间很快就产生了相互的吸引力。

在他们的婚礼当天——一场噩梦诞生了。

[翻译自[url=https://chattenoire.com/hakoniwa/]官方网站[/url]]
